import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Fraud distribution by transaction type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = df.groupby(['transaction_type', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Fraud Distribution by Transaction Type', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

ax2 = axes[0, 1]
df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'].hist(bins=30, alpha=0.6, label='Legitimate', 
                                         color='#2ecc71', ax=ax2)
df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'].hist(bins=30, alpha=0.6, label='Fraud', 
                                         color='#e74c3c', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Fraud by hour of day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby(['hour_of_day', 'is_fraud']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_fraud.plot(kind='line', ax=ax3, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], 
                  marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=5)
ax3.set_title('Transaction Patterns by Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax3.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 4. Box plot of amount by fraud status and transaction type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_label', 
            ax=ax4, palette={'Legitimate': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'})
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontweight='bold')

ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)')

ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
